transcript.text: Hi everyone. I'm Mara, your Production Designer. I'll be reviewing the current draft for the televised dance special with all of you before I give my final approval on the stage plan. As I understand it, we're filming at the Atrium Theater on Friday, and the draft currently includes a rotating platform, an overhead lift, floor anchors drilled into the stage, and a two-meter camera lane. Before I sign off, I need to make sure the platform, anchoring, camera-lane, and movement selections are all checked together as one compatible stage plan. So let's start going through it — what are the technical, location, and movement considerations I should be aware of?

The approved replacement requires exactly 18 ballast bases for a freestanding platform. I have the written restriction, but it hasn't been added to the location packet yet, so the draft still shows floor anchors drilled into the stage, which won't be permitted at this venue.
